Every table the package returns is documented in a machine-readable data dictionary shipped with the package, written in the data-dict.yaml format (spec 0.1.0): column types, ranges, representative values, masking semantics, cross-table relationships, and a glossary of TEA vocabulary. This vignette renders that file – it is generated from the same dictionary your code can read, so the two can never drift apart:

dict <- yaml::read_yaml(
  system.file("data-dict.yaml", package = "txschools")
)
length(dict$tables)
#> [1] 14

Two conventions apply everywhere and are worth internalizing before reading the tables:

  • Years are ending years. year = 2025 means the 2024-25 school year, matching TEA’s URLs; school_year is the label form.
  • Identifiers are zero-padded strings. Campus numbers are nine digits, district numbers six; keeping them as strings preserves leading zeros.

Campus and district directory

directory — One row per Texas campus, district, region, or the state, for one school year. The name-to-identifier lookup behind txs_find_campus() and txs_find_district(). Returned by txs_directory().

column type required description values / examples
year number(ordinal) yes School year ending calendar year. 2013 to 2026
level enum yes campus, district, region, state
id string yes TEA organization identifier. Nine digits for a campus (county-district-campus), six for a district; zero-padded. 161920102, 161920, 12, TX
name string yes Entity name as published by TEA (upper case). CHINA SPRING EL, CHINA SPRING ISD
district string Owning district’s six-digit number; null above district level. 161920, 057905
district_name string CHINA SPRING ISD, DALLAS ISD
county_name string MCLENNAN, DALLAS
region string Education Service Center region number. 12, 10
grade_span string Grades served, as published. EE-05, PK-12, 09-12

TAPR student-information datasets

tapr_student — Nine semantic datasets parsed from a TAPR campus or district report’s student-information page, one requested entity-year per pull. Grain: one row per category value (e.g. one grade level) per entity-year and basis. Returned inside the named list from txs_get_tapr(); the datasets grade, ethnic, sex, cohorts, program, disability, mobility, attrition, and retention all share this shape.

The category column is named for the dataset: grade in the grade dataset (documented below as the representative), ethnic, sex, cohort, program, disability, mobility, attrition, or retention in the others. Every measure column travels with <measure>_masked (true when TEA suppressed the value) and <measure>_mask_code (the verbatim suppression marker) companions.

column type required description values / examples
year number(ordinal) yes 2013 to 2026
school_year string yes Label form of year. 2024-25, 2023-24
level enum yes campus, district
geography string yes Campus (9-digit) or district (6-digit) number, zero-padded. 161920102, 161920
entity_name string CHINA SPRING EL
district_name string CHINA SPRING ISD
county_name string MCLENNAN
source_url string TEA report page this row was parsed from. https://rptsvr1.tea.texas.gov/cgi/sas/broker?...
retrieved_at datetime When the page was retrieved. 2026-01-01T00:00:00Z to 2027-01-01T00:00:00Z
basis string Row context on the report (membership vs enrollment, etc.). membership, enrollment
grade string Category column, named for the dataset requested (see table details). For the grade dataset, the grade level. Kindergarten, Grade 3, Early Childhood Education
count number(quantity) [students] Student count as printed; null when masked. 0 to 10000
count_masked boolean
count_mask_code string Verbatim TEA suppression marker when masked. *, ., -, n/a, <1%
campus_percent number(quantity) [proportion] Campus share of the category as a proportion (“49.6%” parses to 0.496). Null when masked. 0 to 1
campus_percent_masked boolean
campus_percent_mask_code string *, .
district_percent number(quantity) [proportion] 0 to 1
district_percent_masked boolean
district_percent_mask_code string *, .
state_percent number(quantity) [proportion] 0 to 1
state_percent_masked boolean
state_percent_mask_code string *, .

TAPR average class sizes

tapr_class_size — Average class size by grade or subject for one entity-year, with campus, district, and state comparison values. The class_size dataset from txs_get_tapr(). Grain: one row per class-size measure per entity-year.

Shares the identity columns of tapr_student (year, school_year, level, geography, entity_name, district_name, county_name, source_url, retrieved_at, basis); only the measure columns differ and are documented here. Each measure carries _masked/_mask_code companions as in tapr_student.

column type required description values / examples
class_size string yes The class-size measure (grade or subject). Kindergarten, Grade 6, English/Language Arts
campus_class_size number(quantity) [students per class] 0 to 40
district_class_size number(quantity) [students per class] 0 to 40
state_class_size number(quantity) [students per class] 0 to 40

TAPR report-page datasets (generic long form)

tapr_report — Cell-level long form of a TAPR report page for one entity-year. The datasets staar_performance, staar_progress, bilingual_esl, ccmr, graduation, attendance, staff, and finance from txs_get_tapr() all share this shape. Grain: one row per table cell of the report page (a row label crossed with a comparison-group column).

Shares the identity columns of tapr_student (year, school_year, level, geography, entity_name, district_name, county_name, source_url, retrieved_at). value_num is the number as printed by TEA: “90%” parses to 90, “$4,668” to 4668.

column type required description values / examples
page_source enum yes Which TAPR page the cell came from. The attendance dataset is a filtered slice of the graduation page (TEA’s combined attendance/graduation/dropout report). student, staar_performance, staar_progress, bilingual_esl, ccmr, graduation, staff, finance
table_index number(ordinal) Position of the source table on the page. 1 to 60
row_index number(ordinal) 1 to 500
section string Section heading context (TEA’s colspan headings). Grade 3 Reading, STAAR Performance Rates
row_label string yes All Students, Approaches Grade Level or Above
column string yes Comparison-group column header. Campus, District, State, African American
value string yes Cell value exactly as printed, masking codes intact. 90%, $6,568, 23.1, *
value_num number(quantity) Numeric parse of value; null when masked or non-numeric. -Inf to Inf
masked boolean yes
mask_code string *, ., -, <1%

TAPR statewide data files (tidy long form)

tapr_file — One statewide advanced-download data file (every campus or district in Texas for one year and dataset code such as REF or STAAR1), pivoted long. Returned by txs_get_tapr_file(). Grain: one row per entity per variable code.

Identifier columns mirror the file as published and vary by level: campus files carry a CAMPUS column, district files DISTRICT, and so on (zero-padded strings). Decode variable_code with the tapr_dictionary table.

column type required description values / examples
year number(ordinal) yes 2013 to 2026
school_year string yes 2023-24
level enum yes campus, district, region, state
variable_code string yes TEA variable mnemonic; see tapr_dictionary. CAMPNAME, CA00AR01S24R, CDALLC
value string Value as published, masking codes intact. 90, -1, CHINA SPRING EL
value_num number(quantity) Numeric parse of value; null when masked or non-numeric. -Inf to Inf
masked boolean yes
mask_code string *, ., -1

TAPR variable dictionary

tapr_dictionary — TEA’s statewide variable dictionary workbooks parsed to one row per variable: the decoder for tapr_file.variable_code. Returned by txs_get_tapr_dictionary().

column type required description values / examples
year number(ordinal) yes 2013 to 2026
school_year string yes 2023-24
level enum yes campus, district, region, state
sheet string Workbook sheet the variable was documented on. cref, cstaar1
dataset string Advanced-download dataset code the variable belongs to. REF, STAAR1, PROF
variable string yes CAMPNAME, CPETALLC
label string yes Human-readable variable definition. Campus Name, Campus 2024 All Students Count

AEIS statewide data files (tidy long form)

aeis — One statewide AEIS data file (2004-2012) by level and dataset code (e.g. ref, stud, fin), pivoted long. Returned by txs_get_aeis(). Grain: one row per entity per variable code.

Same tidy machinery as tapr_file: identifier columns mirror the file as published (CAMPUS or DISTRICT, zero-padded strings), and the record layout is available via txs_get_aeis(layout = TRUE).

column type required description values / examples
year number(ordinal) yes 2004 to 2012
school_year string yes 2010-11
level enum yes campus, district, region, state
variable_code string yes DISTNAME, DPETALLC
value string CHINA SPRING ISD, 2456, -1
value_num number(quantity) -Inf to Inf
masked boolean yes
mask_code string *, ., -1

School Report Card (HTML era, tidy long form)

src — One campus’s School Report Card for one year (2004-2012), parsed from TEA’s fixed-width HTML into cell-level long form. Returned by txs_get_src(). Grain: one row per report line item per comparison-group column. (2013-2019 reports are PDF-only and are returned as a one-row file descriptor instead; 2020+ lives at txschools.gov, out of package scope.)

column type required description values / examples
year number(ordinal) yes 2004 to 2012
school_year string yes 2010-11
level enum yes campus, district
geography string yes 161920102
school_name string CHINA SPRING EL
district_name string CHINA SPRING ISD
page number(ordinal) 1 to 10
section string TAKS Performance, Attendance
measure string Reading, Attendance Rate
row_label string All Students, Grade 4
column string Campus, District, State
value string yes 94.0%, *
value_num number(quantity) -Inf to Inf
masked boolean yes
mask_code string *, .

PEIMS financial data (budget or actual)

peims_finance — TEA’s statewide PEIMS single-file financial data: one row per district (or charter) x fund x function x object x organizational unit x program intent, for one school year and basis. Returned by txs_get_peims_finance(); also the shape of the peims_finance_<basis>_<type>_<year> tables that txs_write_peims_db() writes to DuckDB. District actual files run to several million rows per year.

The *_label, district_name, and campus_name columns are joined from TEA’s companion code tables when labels = TRUE (the default) and are absent when the code tables cannot be fetched or labels = FALSE. Charter files use TEA’s nonprofit chart of accounts; their asset/function/object/program-intent codes are normalized into the same columns. No FERPA masking applies to this table: values are dollar amounts, not student counts. Negative amounts are genuine (refunds, adjustments, contra accounts).

column type required description values / examples
district string yes Six-digit district number, zero-padded; charters included. 161920, 001902, 003801
district_name string CHINA SPRING ISD, PINEYWOODS COMMUNITY ACADEMY
fin_unit string yes Three-digit organizational (fin) unit within the district; campus number where applicable, “000” for no cost center, “999” for undistributed. 000, 001, 101, 999
campus_name string CHINA SPRING H S, NO COST CENTER, UNDISTRIBUTED
year number(ordinal) yes 2000 to 2026
school_year string yes 2023-24, 1999-00
basis enum yes actual, budget
type enum yes district, charter
fund_code string yes Three-digit fund code (199 = general fund). 199, 211, 240, 420, 599
fund_label string GENERAL FUND, FOUNDATION SCHOOL PROGRAM
function_code string yes Two-digit function (11 = instruction). 11, 23, 35, 51, 71
function_label string INSTRUCTION, FACILITY MAINTENANCE AND OPERATIONS
object_code string yes Four-digit object. 5xxx are revenues, 6xxx expenditures (61xx payroll, 62xx contracted services, 63xx supplies, 64xx other operating, 65xx debt service, 66xx capital outlay), 3xxx fund balances. 5749, 6119, 6341, 3600
object_label string SALARIES OR WAGES - TEACHERS AND OTHER PROFESSIONAL PERSONNEL
program_intent_code string Two-digit program intent (11 = basic educational services). 00, 11, 23, 30
program_intent_label string BASIC EDUCATIONAL SERVICES, TITLE I, PART A SCHOOLWIDE ACTIVITIES
amount number(quantity) [USD] yes Budgeted or actual dollars; negatives are genuine. -100000000 to 2000000000
fiscal_year number(ordinal) Fiscal year as recorded in the file; equals year. 2000 to 2026
updated date TEA’s last-update stamp for the row. 2000-01-01 to 2027-12-31

PEIMS provenance table (_peims_meta)

peims_meta — Written alongside every txs_write_peims_db() call: one row per table write, recording where and when the data came from. Stored in DuckDB as _peims_meta.

column type required description values / examples
table string yes peims_finance_actual_district_2024
year number(ordinal) 2000 to 2026
school_year string 2023-24
basis enum actual, budget
type enum district, charter
source_url string https://tea.texas.gov/data-reports/financial-reports/school-finance-reports-and-data/actget2024.zip
retrieved_at string ISO 8601 retrieval timestamp of the source file. 2026-07-18T23:03:55Z
sha256 string SHA-256 of the downloaded source file. 29785442f150...
written_at string ISO 8601 timestamp of the database write. 2026-07-18T23:04:12Z

School district property tax rates

tax_rates — One row per district per school year: adopted M&O and I&S property-tax rates merged from the Texas Comptroller’s annual rates-and-levies workbooks (tax years 2019 onward, primary) and TEA’s adopted-tax-rates workbook (2005-06 onward, backfill). Returned by txs_get_tax_rates(). Rates are dollars per $100 of taxable value.

txs_derive_pennies() appends the HB3 decomposition columns (tier_one_rate, golden_rate, copper_rate, enrichment_rate, golden_pennies, copper_pennies); they are NA whenever mcr is NA. mcr itself is a user-supplied pluggable input – TEA publishes no clean statewide Maximum Compressed Rate file – so it is NA unless the caller provides one.

column type required description values / examples
year number(ordinal) yes 2006 to 2027
school_year string yes 2023-24, 2005-06
district string yes Six-digit county-district number, zero-padded. 161920, 057905
district_name string CHINA SPRING ISD, China Spring ISD
mo_rate number(quantity) [USD per $100 taxable value] yes 0 to 2
is_rate number(quantity) [USD per $100 taxable value] 0 to 1
total_rate number(quantity) [USD per $100 taxable value] From the Comptroller file where published, else mo_rate plus is_rate. 0 to 3
mcr number(quantity) [USD per $100 taxable value] Maximum Compressed Rate; NA unless supplied by the caller. 0 to 2
rate_source enum yes comptroller, tea

FIRST financial integrity ratings

first_ratings — One row per school district or open-enrollment charter per rating year: TEA’s Financial Integrity Rating System of Texas (FIRST) rating, from School FIRST (districts, 2002-03 onward) and Charter FIRST (charters, 2011-12 onward). Returned by txs_get_first(). Each rating year’s ratings are computed from the prior fiscal year’s audited financial data.

The rating system changed over time, so compare score within an era: 2002-03 to 2013-14 used achievement labels (“Superior Achievement” through “Substandard Achievement”) on 65-85 point scales; 2014-15 was pass/fail on 30 points; from 2015-16 ratings are letter grades (A, B, C, F) on 100 points. University charters, rated pass/fail in a separate list since 2017-18, have university_charter = true and no score. TEA posts preliminary ratings in August and final ratings by mid-November; School FIRST labels every workbook “Final”, so release marks district rows downloaded before December 1 of the rating year as preliminary, and charter rows follow TEA’s own label.

column type required description values / examples
year number(ordinal) yes Ending rating year; 2026 means the 2025-26 ratings. 2003 to 2026
school_year string yes 2025-26, 2002-03
fiscal_year number(ordinal) yes Fiscal year whose audited financial data was rated (year - 1); joins peims_finance.fiscal_year. 2002 to 2025
type enum yes district, charter
university_charter boolean yes True for rows from TEA’s separate university-charter list (2017-18 onward; pass/fail, no score).
district string yes Six-digit district number, zero-padded; charters included. 001902, 161920, 003801
district_name string CAYUGA ISD, PINEYWOODS COMMUNITY ACADEMY
region string Two-digit Education Service Center region. 07, 12
status enum Pass, Fail, Suspended, Undetermined
rating string TEA’s rating label as published, whitespace-trimmed. A = Superior Achievement, A - Superior Achievement, Superior Achievement, Pass, Suspended: No Reason Given
grade enum Letter grade (2015-16 onward); null for earlier years and for pass/fail ratings. A, B, C, F
score number(quantity) [points] FIRST points; the maximum depends on the era (100 since 2015-16). Null for university charters. 0 to 100
release enum yes preliminary, final
last_updated date TEA’s last-update stamp for the row. 2004-01-01 to 2027-12-31

TEA district number to NCES LEAID crosswalk

crosswalk — One row per Texas school district linking TEA’s six-digit county-district number to the seven-digit NCES LEAID (the Census GEOID used by boundary files). Built from the NCES CCD directory via the Urban Institute Education Data API. Returned by txs_crosswalk().

column type required description values / examples
geoid string key Seven-digit NCES LEAID / Census GEOID. 4813960, 4816860
district string yes 161920, 057905
lea_name string CHINA SPRING ISD

District boundaries (sf)

boundaries — Simplified Census cartographic school-district boundaries for Texas in WGS84, one polygon per district, returned as an sf data frame by txs_boundaries(). Join TEA-keyed tables through the crosswalk table.

column type required description values / examples
geoid string key 4813960
name string China Spring ISD
geometry sf polygon geometry (EPSG:4326); not a scalar column.

How the tables relate

join cardinality description
peims_finance.district = directory.district many-to-one A PEIMS finance row’s district resolves to the directory’s district entry for the same year (directory level = "district" rows carry the district number in both id and district).
tapr_student.geography = directory.id many-to-one A TAPR entity’s campus or district number resolves to its directory entry for the same year.
tapr_file.variable_code = tapr_dictionary.variable many-to-one Statewide-file variable codes are defined in the dictionary for the same year and level.
first_ratings.district = directory.district many-to-one A FIRST row’s district or charter resolves to the directory’s district entry (directory level = "district" rows).
first_ratings.district = peims_finance.district AND first_ratings.fiscal_year = peims_finance.fiscal_year one-to-many A rating pairs with the PEIMS actuals it was computed from: the same district in the fiscal year before the rating year (use basis = "actual").
tax_rates.district = crosswalk.district many-to-one Tax-rate rows resolve to Census geography through the crosswalk.
crosswalk.geoid = boundaries.geoid one-to-one The crosswalk’s LEAID is the boundary file’s GEOID.

Glossary

TEA — Texas Education Agency, the state agency overseeing public K-12 education in Texas.

TAPR — Texas Academic Performance Reports (2013-present), TEA’s annual campus/district/region/state report cards; successor to AEIS.

AEIS — Academic Excellence Indicator System (through 2011-12), the predecessor of TAPR.

SRC — School Report Card, a condensed per-campus report TEA publishes alongside TAPR/AEIS.

PEIMS — Public Education Information Management System, TEA’s statewide data collection; its financial submission is the source of the peims_finance table.

campus number — Nine-digit county-district-campus identifier; the first six digits are the district number, the last three the campus. Always handled as a zero-padded string.

district number — Six-digit identifier for a district or open-enrollment charter (charters share the district number space).

ending year — The package identifies school years by their ending calendar year: 2025 means the 2024-25 school year, matching TEA’s URLs.

masking — FERPA-driven suppression TEA applies to small student counts. Masked cells keep their verbatim marker (“*“,”.”, “<1%”, -1 style sentinels) in value/mask_code, with masked = true and a null numeric value. Never imputed. Not applicable to PEIMS finance (dollars, not students).

fund — Revenue source bucket in TEA’s chart of accounts (e.g. 199 general fund, 211 Title I, 240 school nutrition, 599 debt service).

function — Purpose of an expenditure in TEA’s chart of accounts (e.g. 11 instruction, 23 school leadership, 51 facility maintenance and operations, 71 debt service).

object — What was bought or received (e.g. 61xx payroll, 62xx contracted services, 66xx capital outlay; 5xxx revenues).

program intent — Student population an expenditure is intended to serve (e.g. 11 basic educational services, 23 special education).

fin unit — Organizational unit within a district in PEIMS finance; campus number where the money is attributable to a campus, otherwise “000” (no cost center) or “999” (undistributed).

charter — Open-enrollment charter school, reported by TEA under the nonprofit chart of accounts in PEIMS finance and as districts in most other tables.

FIRST — Financial Integrity Rating System of Texas, TEA’s annual financial accountability rating of every district (School FIRST) and charter (Charter FIRST), based on the prior fiscal year’s audited financial data; the source of the first_ratings table.

ESC region — One of twenty Education Service Center regions Texas districts belong to (e.g. Region 12, Waco).

Using the dictionary programmatically

The dictionary is plain YAML, so anything – your code, a colleague’s Python, an AI agent – can consume it directly:

dict <- yaml::read_yaml(system.file("data-dict.yaml", package = "txschools"))

# Column names of the PEIMS finance table:
peims <- Filter(function(t) t$name == "peims_finance", dict$tables)[[1]]
vapply(peims$columns, `[[`, "", "name")

The data-dict CLI can validate the file against the specification, and the same conventions (one data-dict.yaml per data collection) work for documenting your own derived datasets downstream.
